specification:
Prudentia-style bulk file download (stand-in for the SIGCOMM '24 file-transfer category — Dropbox/Drive/OneDrive/Mega all download a 10 GB file; this uses a public speed-test file so no account or upload is needed).
1. Download <secret>url</secret> with wget, discarding the payload to /dev/null. Transfer duration is governed by the file size (pick 1GB.bin/10GB.bin to approximate Prudentia's 600 s workload for your link speed).
2. <secret>timeout_seconds</secret> is wget's network stall/connect timeout, not a duration cap.
